## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector strength coexists with major divergence among mega-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META all BELOW TREND), and leadership is concentrated in semiconductors — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); Style: Mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology led on headline movers with semiconductors strong: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing broad strength: TGT (1W: +10.33% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND, KHC (1W: +8.02% | 1M: +7.13%) ABOVE TREND. Financials also contribute: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is the lone negative sector on the week: XOM (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -2.35%) BELOW TREND. Big-cap Technology internals are mixed-to-weak with AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND. Communication shows dispersion despite some winners: CHTR (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND; ASML (1W: +13.51% | 1M: +17.83%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk present.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -4.42% | 1M: +26.84%) CORRECTION; ACN (1W: -4.47% | 1M: +6.66%) CORRECTION; AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND; PLTR (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -1.58%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in large-cap software/FAANG names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +13.51% | 1M: +17.83%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +10.33% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence among mega-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META) — MAJOR DIVERGENCE; treat moves as tactical until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: semiconductors and equipment are driving gains while large-cap software and ad names lag. AMD (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +14.83%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.04% | 1M: -9.03%) RECOVERY, but AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation and narrow leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND is representative of broader strength; V (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +0.65%) is in CORRECTION and MA (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, but overall sector is supportive on the week. Monitor earnings/news flow for confirmation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive tone but mixed idiosyncratic risk: JNJ (1W: +3.48% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +1.83%) ABOVE TREND, while headline-driven names (AMGN, BMY, ISRG) carry negative sentiment and warrant monitoring. Sector breadth is modestly positive but watch news catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to semiconductors and strong Financial names given current momentum (e.g., INTC, AMAT, JPM) and reduce exposure to mega-cap software/advertising names showing broad weakness (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META). Leadership is narrow and CAUTION is warranted — prioritize liquidity and wait for trend confirmation before expanding beta.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND for semiconductor follow-through. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%) BELOW TREND — watch for distribution on positive/negative headlines.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Semiconductors/Equipment within Technology (leadership narrow but strong); Financials for rate/cyclicals upside. BEARISH: Energy remains the lone soft sector and big-cap Tech internals warrant monitoring for further weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch INTC for follow-through above this week’s highs to confirm continuation; monitor AMAT/LRCX re-testing weekly breakout levels for semis to stay ABOVE TREND. NVDA must regain a positive 1M trend (move back above its 1M level) to shift out of RECOVERY; AAPL/MSFT sustained weakness below recent support would confirm further downside pressure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMD (+60): AMD (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +14.83%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment on AI chips confirms price strength. LRCX (+50): LRCX (1W: +20.95% | 1M: +24.16%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/semicap strength confirmed by price. GOOGL (+55): GOOGL (1W: -2.34% | 1M: -10.61%) BELOW TREND — positive order news is diverging from price, watch for follow-through. ORCL (+50): ORCL (1W: -13.83% | 1M: -2.97%) BELOW TREND — bullish print but price is not confirming, flag as divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMGN (-60): AMGN (sentiment -60) — check relative price path (status not in top lists) as news is negative and may pressure names in Healthcare. META (-45): META (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -8.05%) BELOW TREND — negative headline aligns with price weakness. CME (-50): CME (sentiment -50) — regulatory headlines diverge from sector strength; monitor position sizing and liquidity risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with mixed style; breadth is strong (10/11 sectors positive) but leadership is narrow and concentrated in semiconductors. INTC (1W: +25.61% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +25.22% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.82%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR DIVERGENCE among mega-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, META BELOW TREND) and several sentiment-price divergences (GOOGL, ORCL) that require confirmation before adding beta.
